# 字距呼吸展开

Component ID: shotcraft-tracking-expand

## Narrative intent

用平静的字距展开引入短概念，再补解释，让观众获得可读的章节起点。

Select this recipe only when the current story event needs that audience outcome; the animation alone is not evidence that the outcome was delivered.

## Purpose and selection

- Quiet concept or chapter opening with a short title; keep the camera still.

Do not use:

- Not a replacement for technical diagrams or a long narrated scene. Use at most two title entrance families per video.

## Supported inputs

- title: One short title, 1–8 characters; no paragraphs or line breaks.
- subtitle: One supporting phrase, at most 24 characters. Do not repeat the title.

## Reading order and motion

- Expand compressed characters into a stable title
- Reveal a supporting phrase after the main title settles

Pattern: kinetic-type. Native default duration: 4.4s. Minimum final readable hold: 0.7s.

### expand

- Target: .sc-word
- Visible action: Expand compressed characters into a stable title
- Authored start: 0.65s; action duration: 1.6666666666666667s.
- Narration cue: Bind to the exact measured spoken phrase for: Expand compressed characters into a stable title. Do not estimate from text length.

### subtitle

- Target: .sc-subtitle
- Visible action: Reveal a supporting phrase after the main title settles
- Authored start: 2.35s; action duration: 0.7666666666666667s.
- Narration cue: Bind to the exact measured spoken phrase for: Reveal a supporting phrase after the main title settles. Do not estimate from text length.

## Known failure modes and recovery

- overflow: Split at a semantic boundary or choose a suitable recipe. Do not shrink or truncate text.
- missingInput: Resolve required content and real assets; report a gap instead of using placeholder graphics.
- timingMismatch: Bind measured phrases while preserving original movement ratios and final hold. Split the scene if it does not fit.
- inapplicable: Select another proven recipe; with recipes-only policy, report the library gap rather than author custom graphics.

Under recipes-only policy, missing capability means another validated recipe, a meaningful split or an explicit gap; not custom graphics disguised as reuse.
